Audio sample format.

Matches Symphonia's `SampleFormat` enum. Describes how decoded audio
samples are represented in memory.

## Variants
#### `U8` = 1
Unsigned 8-bit integer.

#### `U16` = 2
Unsigned 16-bit integer.

#### `U24` = 3
Unsigned 24-bit integer (stored in 32 bits).

#### `U32` = 4
Unsigned 32-bit integer.

#### `S8` = 5
Signed 8-bit integer.

#### `S16` = 6
Signed 16-bit integer (CD quality).

#### `S24` = 7
Signed 24-bit integer (professional audio).

#### `S32` = 8
Signed 32-bit integer.

#### `F32` = 9
32-bit IEEE-754 floating point.

#### `F64` = 10
64-bit IEEE-754 floating point.


## Arrow datatype
```
uint8
```
